title: English rewards-points redemption call that asks for the OTP in the very first turn
description: Polite caller from a card rewards desk says points lapse at midnight and that redeeming them needs the OTP that was just sent. The protected-info request comes immediately and is repeated with a ten-minute deadline.

turns.text: Good evening sir, this is Rohan from the rewards desk at Crown Bank. Your credit card has eighteen thousand reward points that lapse at midnight. To convert them to cash I only need the OTP that has just come to your phone.
It is just a formality, sir. Once you read the OTP out, the amount is credited straight away and the points are redeemed.
The redemption window closes in ten minutes. Could you please check your messages and read the OTP to me now?

title: Hindi-script PAN-update call: account will freeze today unless PAN and OTP are given
description: Caller says the PAN has not been updated and the savings account will be frozen by evening. She asks for the PAN number first and the OTP in the same breath, then threatens that no money can be withdrawn from tomorrow.

turns.text: नमस्कार जी, मैं आपके बैंक की सर्विस ब्रांच से कविता बोल रही हूँ। आपके खाते में पैन कार्ड अपडेट नहीं हुआ है, इसलिए आज शाम तक खाता फ्रीज़ हो सकता है।
अभी मैं आपका पैन नंबर नोट कर लेती हूँ, वो बता दीजिए। फिर आपके मोबाइल पर एक ओटीपी आएगा, वो भी मुझे पढ़कर सुना दीजिएगा।
देखिए, ये सिर्फ़ दो मिनट का काम है। अगर आपने ओटीपी नहीं बताया तो कल से आप खाते से एक रुपया भी नहीं निकाल पाएँगे।

title: Noisy Hinglish failed-UPI refund call: refund 'needs' the OTP and the card expiry date

refund ke liye aapke mobile pe ek otp aaya hoga wo bata do aur card ki expiry date bhi taaki transaction match ho jaye
sir otp nahi bataya toh ye paisa company ke account me chala jayega phir wapas nahi aayega jaldi bolo

title: Kannada-script 'UPI limit upgrade' call asking the owner to say the UPI PIN
description: Caller from a supposed bank UPI service division says the daily limit is being raised for free and asks for the UPI PIN as confirmation, then pressures that the UPI service will stop today. The PIN request starts in turn 2.

turns.text: ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ ಸರ್, ನಾನು ಬ್ಯಾಂಕಿನ ಯುಪಿಐ ಸರ್ವಿಸ್ ವಿಭಾಗದಿಂದ ಮಾತಾಡ್ತಿದ್ದೀನಿ. ನಿಮ್ಮ ದಿನದ ಯುಪಿಐ ಲಿಮಿಟ್ ಒಂದು ಲಕ್ಷದಿಂದ ಐದು ಲಕ್ಷಕ್ಕೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸ್ತಿದ್ದೀವಿ.
ಇದಕ್ಕೆ ಯಾವ ಚಾರ್ಜೂ ಇಲ್ಲ ಸರ್. ಕನ್ಫರ್ಮೇಷನ್‌ಗೆ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಯುಪಿಐ ಪಿನ್ ಹೇಳಿದ್ರೆ ಸಾಕು, ನಾನೇ ಅಪ್‌ಡೇಟ್ ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ.
ಪಿನ್ ಕೊಡೋಕೆ ಹಿಂಜರೀಬೇಡಿ ಸರ್, ಇದು ಬ್ಯಾಂಕಿನ ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆ. ಇವತ್ತೇ ಮಾಡದಿದ್ರೆ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಯುಪಿಐ ಸೇವೆ ನಿಂತುಹೋಗುತ್ತೆ.

title: Slow-build Kanglish pre-approved-loan call: name, then PAN and Aadhaar, then the OTP 'for the e-signature'
description: Friendly caller from a bank loan desk spreads the sensitive requests over four turns: first the owner's full name, then PAN and Aadhaar numbers 'to run the check', then a one-time code he insists is only an e-signature code, and finally a deadline. No single early utterance looks alarming.

turns.text: Hello sir, namaste, Pioneer Bank inda Ramesh matadtidini. Nimma number ge ondu pre-approved personal loan ide, avara full name swalpa confirm maadtira?
Mooru laksha varegu loan ide sir, interest kooda kadime. Process start maadoke avara PAN number mattu Aadhaar number nange heli, naanu system alli check madtini.
Ivaga ondu OTP baruthe sir, adu e-sign ge, loan agreement ge sign aagoke. Adanna nange heli, OTP anta bhaya padbedi, just signature code.
Sir ee offer ivattu mathra valid, message bandide alva, ippa heli sir.

notes: The caller calls the one-time code an 'e-signature code'; it is still an OTP read out over the phone, so the OTP request signal is expected.

title: English 'new device login' alert that slowly leads to reading out a six digit verification code
description: Caller from a bank digital-security desk reports a blocked login from a new phone, checks the registered number, and only in turn 3 asks the owner to read out the six digit verification code that has just been sent; repeated with a deadline in turn 4.

turns.text: Hello, this is Sunita from the digital security desk of Lotus Bank. A login to your net banking was attempted from a new phone in another city a few minutes ago and our system has put it on hold.
Is this the number registered with the bank? Thank you. The request is still pending, so the new device can still be stopped from our side.
A six digit verification code has just been sent to your phone. To block that device I will need you to read the code out to me.
If the code is not confirmed in the next few minutes the device gets full access to the account, so please check the message and read it out.

notes: The word OTP is never used; 'six digit verification code ... read out' is the request.

title: Hinglish dormant-account closure call asking for the full card number, expiry date and CVV
description: Caller says the savings account is inactive and will be closed this month and that it can be kept alive only by reading out the card number, expiry date and the three digits on the back. No OTP is involved; the ask is direct in turn 2.

turns.text: Namaste ji, main Vikram bol raha hoon bank ki account maintenance team se. Aapka savings account kaafi time se inactive hai, is mahine ke end tak close kar diya jayega.
Account chalu rakhne ke liye bas card verify karna hai. Card ka poora number, expiry date aur peeche wale teen digit, ye teeno bata dijiye.
Sir ghabraiye mat, koi paisa nahi katega, sirf verification hai. Jab tak ye detail nahi milti main account band hone se rok nahi sakta.

title: Noisy Kanglish 'my recovery code came to your number by mistake' call asking to read out the six digit code
description: Garbled lowercase transcript with dropped words and very low confidence. Caller says he typed a wrong number and a six digit account-recovery code meant for him went to the owner's phone, and pleads for it to be read out. No organisation is named; account-takeover pretext.

turns.text: hello sir sorry sir wrong number nanna account recovery ge ondu code nimma number ge bandide anta gottaytu
adu six digit code nange helbeku sir nanna account lock aagide ippage nange beku pls pls
sir nimge message bandide alva nodi ondu nimisha code nange heli nanna job ge thumba important ide

notes: Hard to classify by language and by organisation; the only reliable cue is a request to read out a code that arrived by SMS.

title: English Income Tax 'notice' call: unreported deposits, settle today by transfer to avoid prosecution
description: Caller poses as an Income Tax investigation officer, asks to speak to the assessee, cites unreported cash deposits and a file with the prosecution section, and only in turn 3 offers to settle for a lump sum to be deposited today; attachment and a visit are threatened in turn 4.

turns.text: Good morning. This is Inspector Raghavan from the Income Tax investigation wing. Am I speaking with the assessee or his representative?
A notice has been generated against this PAN for unreported cash deposits of nearly eleven lakh rupees over the last two years. The file is now with the prosecution section.

The matter can still be settled today without prosecution. He needs to deposit a settlement amount of one lakh eighty thousand rupees into the department's holding account, and I will share the details right now.
If this is not done by five o'clock his bank accounts will be attached and a team will visit the residence, so please inform him immediately.

title: Hindi-script traffic e-challan call threatening licence suspension and an FIR unless a fine is paid on UPI
description: Caller claims to be a head constable at a traffic police control room, says the vehicle was challaned three times for jumping a signal, threatens licence suspension and an FIR today, and demands the fine over UPI with a receipt promised on WhatsApp.

turns.text: हेलो, मैं ट्रैफिक पुलिस कंट्रोल रूम से हवलदार यादव बोल रहा हूँ। आपकी गाड़ी का तीन बार सिग्नल तोड़ने का चालान कटा है और अभी तक भरा नहीं गया।
आज के आज जुर्माना नहीं भरा तो आपका लाइसेंस सस्पेंड हो जाएगा और गाड़ी के नंबर पर एफआईआर दर्ज कर दी जाएगी।
तीन हज़ार चार सौ रुपये का जुर्माना है, अभी यूपीआई से भेज दीजिए, मैं आपको नंबर बताता हूँ। रसीद आपको व्हाट्सएप पर मिल जाएगी।

title: Noisy Hinglish 'digital arrest': online-fraud complaints against the SIM, stay on the video call, tell nobody, fund 'verification'
description: Lowercase unpunctuated transcript. A supposed cyber-cell inspector says fourteen people have complained about fraud from the owner's SIM, orders the call to stay connected and family not to be told, threatens an arrest on camera and finally asks for money to be put in a department account for 'verification'.

ye ek serious case hai aap abhi video call pe aaiye aur call kaatna mat jab tak main na bolu kisi ko phone mat karna ghar walo ko bhi nahi
agar aapne cooperation nahi kiya toh digital arrest ho jayega phir team ghar pahunch jayegi aur account ki verification ke liye paisa hamare account me daalna padega

title: Kanglish 'your brother is in police custody' call asking for money at once so that no FIR is registered
description: Caller says he is a sub-inspector, claims the owner's younger brother was caught after an accident while drunk, and asks for money over UPI immediately to settle the case quietly. Immediate ask, emotional pressure, secrecy and a ticking clock.

FIR haakidre avana career ge problem aagutte sir, adakke ippage hattu saavira rupees UPI maadi, case settle maadkobeku. Yaarigu helbedi.
Sir time illa, avanu lock-up alli kootkondidare, ippage duddu hakidre ondu gante alli bidtivi. Illandre FIR register aagutte.

title: Hindi-script courier call: re-delivery charge on UPI plus 'send your live location and full address'
description: Caller from a courier warehouse says a parcel has been lying there because the address is unclear, asks for a small re-delivery charge over UPI so that it is not returned, and then asks for the owner's live location and complete address on WhatsApp.

turns.text: नमस्ते जी, मैं अमित बोल रहा हूँ स्विफ्ट कार्गो कूरियर से। आपका एक पार्सल दो दिन से हमारे गोदाम में पड़ा है, पता साफ़ न होने की वजह से डिलीवरी नहीं हो पा रही।
पार्सल वापस भेजने से पहले रोकने के लिए पचासी रुपये का रीशेड्यूल चार्ज यूपीआई से देना होगा। मैं अभी आपको पेमेंट का नंबर भेजता हूँ।
और डिलीवरी बॉय के लिए आप व्हाट्सएप पर अपनी लाइव लोकेशन भेज दीजिए या घर का पूरा पता बता दीजिए, तभी पार्सल निकलेगा।

title: Kanglish 'gift parcel from abroad' call that ends in a customs-clearance payment demand
description: Caller from a logistics customs desk says a friend abroad has sent a gift parcel with a watch, perfume and cash that is held at customs, and asks for clearance charges on UPI, promising a receipt on WhatsApp for the customs officer. The payment demand arrives only in turn 3 and is repeated with the threat of an auction.

turns.text: Hello sir, namaste, nanu Blue Arrow Logistics customs desk inda Naveen matadtidini. Nimge London inda ondu gift parcel bandide, nimma friend Daniel avaru kalsiddaare anta.
Parcel nalli watch, perfume mattu cash kooda ide anta scan alli kandide. Adakke customs clearance aagbeku sir.
Clearance charge eight thousand five hundred rupees sir, adu UPI maadbeku. Receipt WhatsApp alli kalsthini, adannu customs officer ge torsi parcel release maadsthini.
Ippa maadidre ivattu sanje ge parcel mane ge baruthe. Illandre customs alli auction aagutte, nanna UPI id ge haaki saaku.

title: Code-switching 'lost parcel compensation' call: accept a UPI collect request and enter your PIN to receive the money
description: Caller from a courier claims cell starts in Kanglish, moves to English and ends in Hinglish. He says a lost parcel entitles the owner to a compensation credit that will arrive once a UPI request is accepted and the UPI PIN is entered. The payment trick is disguised as a refund.

turns.text: Hello sir, namaskara, nanu courier claims cell inda maatadthidini. Nimma parcel transit alli lost aagide, adakke company compensation kodtide sir.
Sir, the compensation is five thousand two hundred rupees. I am sending a request to your UPI app right now. You only have to accept it and the amount will be credited.
Haan sir bas wo request accept kijiye, phir UPI pin daalna padega tabhi paisa aapke account mein aayega, isme koi risk nahi hai.
Please do it now sir, the claim expires today and I cannot extend it.

notes: A collect request is a payment request in disguise: 'accept it and the money is credited' is the trap.

title: Kannada-script free '5G upgrade' call asking the owner to install a support app and read out its code
description: Caller from a supposed mobile-network company offers a free upgrade, asks the owner to install a support app from the Play Store, read out the code it shows and then leave the phone to him to 'set up'. No money is mentioned.

turns.text: ಹಲೋ ಸರ್, ನಿಮ್ಮ ನಂಬರ್‌ಗೆ ಒಂದು ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಸುದ್ದಿ ಇದೆ. ಮೊಬೈಲ್ ನೆಟ್‌ವರ್ಕ್ ಕಂಪನಿಯಿಂದ ಕರೆ ಮಾಡ್ತಿದ್ದೀನಿ, ನಿಮಗೆ ಉಚಿತವಾಗಿ ಫೈವ್ ಜಿ ಅಪ್‌ಗ್ರೇಡ್ ಬಂದಿದೆ.
ಅದನ್ನ ಆಕ್ಟಿವೇಟ್ ಮಾಡೋಕೆ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಫೋನ್‌ಗೆ ಒಂದು ಸಪೋರ್ಟ್ ಆ್ಯಪ್ ಹಾಕ್ಕೊಳ್ಳಿ, ಪ್ಲೇ ಸ್ಟೋರ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಸಿಗುತ್ತೆ.
ಆ ಆ್ಯಪ್ ಓಪನ್ ಮಾಡಿದ್ರೆ ಒಂದು ಕೋಡ್ ಬರುತ್ತೆ, ಅದನ್ನ ನನಗೆ ಹೇಳಿ. ಆಮೇಲೆ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಫೋನ್ ನಾನೇ ಸೆಟ್ ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ, ನೀವು ನೋಡ್ತಾ ಕೂತ್ರೆ ಸಾಕು.

title: Code-switching 'system licence expired' tech-support call: install AnyDesk, read out the code, then the email password

आप चिंता मत कीजिए, मैं अभी ठीक कर देता हूँ। बस आप अपने लैपटॉप पर एनीडेस्क नाम का सॉफ्टवेयर डाउनलोड कर लीजिए।
Download aadmele screen mele ond nine digit code baruthe sir, adanna nange heli. Naanu remote alli licence renew maadtini.
And sir, for the licence key I also need the password of the email you use on that laptop. Please tell me, it takes two minutes.

title: English gas-agency 'connection will be disconnected' call demanding a small UPI payment to a personal number
description: Caller claims to be from a gas agency billing section, says two cylinder bookings are unpaid and the connection will be cut tomorrow, and asks for a small amount over UPI to a personal number with a screenshot on WhatsApp. Plain-spoken, no OTP or card details.

turns.text: Hello, this is the billing section of your gas agency. Your last two cylinder bookings are showing as unpaid and the connection is marked for disconnection tomorrow morning.
It is just six hundred and forty rupees pending. You can clear it right now on UPI to our accountant's personal number, I will tell you the number.
Once the payment is done please send me the screenshot on WhatsApp. If it is not done today the supply will be stopped and reconnection costs much more.

title: Hindi-script 'college friend stranded at a foreign airport' call asking for gift-voucher codes
description: Caller introduces himself as an old college friend on a new number, claims to be stuck at an airport abroad after losing his wallet, and only in turn 3 asks the owner to buy online gift vouchers and read out the codes; secrecy and a flight deadline follow.

turns.text: नमस्ते, मैं संदीप बोल रहा हूँ, आपके साथ कॉलेज में था। नंबर बदल गया है, ये मेरा नया नंबर है। कैसे हैं आप?
यार एक मुसीबत में फँस गया हूँ। अभी बैंकॉक एयरपोर्ट पर हूँ, पर्स गुम हो गया और यहाँ कार्ड भी नहीं चल रहा। किसी को बताया नहीं है अभी तक।
आप ऑनलाइन दस हज़ार रुपये के गिफ्ट वाउचर खरीद दीजिए और उनके कोड मुझे बता दीजिए, एयरलाइन काउंटर पर वही चल जाएँगे। घर पहुँचकर तुरंत लौटा दूँगा।
प्लीज़ जल्दी कीजिए, फ्लाइट का समय निकल रहा है, और घर पर किसी को मत बताइएगा।

notes: Human review is accepted as an alternate because the owner may know someone called Sandeep; the voucher-code demand with secrecy is the scam signature.

title: Kanglish 'USDT arbitrage' call: pay five thousand on UPI, receive USDT, resell it to 'my client' for a quick profit

Nange five thousand rupees UPI maadi, nanu USDT kodtini, adannu nanna client ge maaribidi, avaru nimma account ge hattu saavira haakthaare.
Ivattu mathra rate ide sir, naale hogutte. Modalu ond sala try maadi, laabha nodidre nimge gotthaagutte.

title: Kanglish 'festival lucky draw: you won a car' call asking for GST and registration charges on UPI
description: Caller from a supposed mall promotion team says the owner's bill number won first prize in a festival draw and that GST and registration charges must be paid on UPI before the car papers are couriered, with a same-evening deadline.

Congratulations sir! Aadre car register maadoke GST mattu registration charges kattbeku, total fourteen thousand five hundred rupees, adu UPI maadi.
Payment confirm aadre naale ge car documents kalsthini sir. Ivattu sanje ge kattalla andre next winner ge hogutte, please bega.

title: Noisy Hinglish 'WhatsApp number won a draw' call that wants the code arriving on the phone to 'register the prize'

turns.text: congratulations sir aapka whatsapp number independence day lucky draw me select hua hai aapne barah lakh ka inaam jeeta hai
inaam aapke account me bhejne ke liye aapke number pe ek code aayega wo mujhe bata dijiye taaki prize aapke naam register ho jaye
sir code abhi nahi bataya toh ye inaam agle winner ko chala jayega sirf paanch minute bache hai jaldi bataiye

notes: No fee or payment is requested; the code that 'will arrive' is the one-time password the caller is after.

title: English bank 'cashback app' call that tells the owner to install an APK from an SMS link and call back if it fails
description: Caller says a cashback is waiting and asks the owner to open a link in an SMS, download an app file outside the store and allow installation from unknown sources; if the link fails he asks for a call back on a helpline number from the same message. Cashback is said to lapse at midnight.

turns.text: Hi, this is Meghana from the customer rewards team of your bank. There is a cashback of two thousand five hundred rupees waiting on your account, valid only till tonight.
I have sent you an SMS with a link. Please open it and download the rewards app file. It is not on the store yet, so your phone will ask permission to install from unknown sources. Just allow it.
If the link does not open, please call me back on the helpline number given in that message and I will guide you step by step. The cashback lapses at midnight.

title: Telugu-script call about an income-tax refund that needs a link in an SMS or a call back
description: Unsupported language (Telugu, native script).
